verses.sloka: ततः तत् अमृत आस्वादम् गृध्र राजेन भाषितम् ।निशम्य मुदितो हृष्टाः ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः ॥४-५९-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tat amṛta āsvādam gṛdhra rājena bhāṣitam ।niśamya mudito hṛṣṭāḥ te vacaḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ॥4-59-1॥

translations.english: The mighty monkeys were delighted to hear the nectarlike words of the king of vultures.
translations.hindi: किष्किन्धाकारड का उनसठबाँ सर्ग पूरा हुआ आगमन रा हुआ |, .... १ कालसज्धेन--कालविलंवेन । (गो०) (७ षष्टितमः सगः —§B— ततः कृतोदकं स्नातं तं गुघ्रं हरियूथपाः । उपविष्टा गिरौ दुर्गे परिवार्य समन्ततः

verses.sloka: जांबवान् वानर श्रेष्ठः सह सर्वैः प्लवंगमैः ।भू तलात् सहसा उत्थाय गृध्र राजानम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५९-२॥
verses.transliteration: jāṁbavān vānara śreṣṭhaḥ saha sarvaiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ ।bhū talāt sahasā utthāya gṛdhra rājānam abravīt ॥4-59-2॥

translations.english: Jambavan the king of bears got up at once from the ground along with the monkeys and spoke to the king of vultures:
translations.hindi: सब वानरों सहित अङ्गद के समीप वेठा हुआ सम्पाति उनको विश्वास कराता हुआ हर्षित हो फिर यह बोला

verses.sloka: क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम् ।तत् आख्यातु भवान् सर्वम् गतिः भव वन ओकसाम् ॥४-५९-३॥
verses.transliteration: kva sītā kena vā dṛṣṭā ko vā harati maithilīm ।tat ākhyātu bhavān sarvam gatiḥ bhava vana okasām ॥4-59-3॥

translations.english: 'Where is Sita now? By whom else was she seen while being carried? Pray, tell us everything. You are the ultimate saviour of monkeys.
translations.hindi: हे वानरो ! आप सब एकाम्र मन कर, में जो कहूँ, उसे सुनो | अब सें आपको यथार्थ रीत्या बतलाउँगा कि, में सोता को किस प्रकार जानता हूँ

verses.sloka: को दाशरथि बाणानाम् वज्र वेग निपातिनाम् ।स्वयम् लक्ष्मणम् मुक्तानाम् न चिंतयति विक्रमम् ॥४-५९-४॥
verses.transliteration: ko dāśarathi bāṇānām vajra vega nipātinām ।svayam lakṣmaṇam muktānām na ciṁtayati vikramam ॥4-59-4॥

translations.english: 'Who is not aware of Rama's swift arrows which are like thunderbolt? Who is not able to assess the speed and power of arrows of Lakshmana released directly?'
translations.hindi: पहले मैं सूर्य के ताप से विकल श्रोर सूर्य की किरणों से जला हुआ इसी विन्ध्याचल की चोटी पर गिरा

verses.sloka: स हरीन् प्रति संयुक्तान् सीता श्रुति समाहितान् ।पुनः आश्वासयन् प्रीत इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५९-५॥
verses.transliteration: sa harīn prati saṁyuktān sītā śruti samāhitān ।punaḥ āśvāsayan prīta idam vacanam abravīt ॥4-59-5॥

translations.english: Pleased to see the happiness and eagernes of the monkeys assembled to hear about Sita, Sampati continued in order to reassure them:
translations.hindi: फिर छः दिन में में सचेत हुआ, परन्तु में ऐसा विवश और विकल था कि, देखने पर भी मुझे; दिशा का ज्ञान नहीं होता था

verses.sloka: श्रूयताम् इह वैदेह्या यथा मे हरणम् श्रुतम् ।येन च अपि मम आख्यातम् यत्र च आयत लोचना ॥४-५९-६॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyatām iha vaidehyā yathā me haraṇam śrutam ।yena ca api mama ākhyātam yatra ca āyata locanā ॥4-59-6॥

translations.english: 'Now hear by whom I was informed about the abduction of the largeeyed princess from Videha and where she is at present.
translations.hindi: कुछ दिनों बाद समुद्र, पहाड़, नदी तालाब, जंगल तथा अन्य विविध स्थानों को देखने से मुझे ज्ञान हुआ

verses.sloka: अहम् अस्मिन् गिरौ दुर्गे बहु योजनम् आयते ।चिरात् निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीण प्राण पराक्रमः ॥४-५९-७॥
verses.transliteration: aham asmin girau durge bahu yojanam āyate ।cirāt nipatito vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇa prāṇa parākramaḥ ॥4-59-7॥

translations.english: 'With my vitality and prowess depleted, I have been staying for a long time on this mountain, extended by several yojanas and inaccessible.

verses.sloka: तम् माम् एवम् गतम् पुत्रः सुपार्श्वो नाम नामतः ।आहारेण यथा कालम् बिभर्ति पतताम् वरः ॥४-५९-८॥
verses.transliteration: tam mām evam gatam putraḥ supārśvo nāma nāmataḥ ।āhāreṇa yathā kālam bibharti patatām varaḥ ॥4-59-8॥

translations.english: 'Reduced to this state, I have been maintained by food given in time by my son named Suparshva, best among birds.
translations.hindi: यहाँ पर देवताओं से पूजित एक आश्रम था। उसमें उग्रतपा निशाकर नामक एक ऋषि रहते थे

verses.sloka: तीक्ष्ण कामाः तु गंधर्वाः तीक्ष्ण कोपा भुजंगमाः ।मृगाणाम् तु भयम् तीक्ष्णम् ततः तीक्ष्ण क्षुधा वयम् ॥४-५९-९॥
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇa kāmāḥ tu gaṁdharvāḥ tīkṣṇa kopā bhujaṁgamāḥ ।mṛgāṇām tu bhayam tīkṣṇam tataḥ tīkṣṇa kṣudhā vayam ॥4-59-9॥

translations.english: 'Gandharvas have intense passion. Serpents show violent anger. Deer have great fear. And we vultures have great hunger.

verses.sloka: स कदाचित् क्षुधा आर्तस्य मम आहार कान्क्षिणः ।गत सूर्यो अहनि प्राप्तो मम पुत्रो हि अनामिषः ॥४-५९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sa kadācit kṣudhā ārtasya mama āhāra kānkṣiṇaḥ ।gata sūryo ahani prāpto mama putro hi anāmiṣaḥ ॥4-59-10॥

translations.english: 'Once my son came to me without meat after sunset while I was feeling hungry for food.

verses.sloka: स मया आहार संरोधात् पीडितः प्रीति वर्धनः ।अनुमान्य यथा तत्त्वम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५९-११॥
verses.transliteration: sa mayā āhāra saṁrodhāt pīḍitaḥ prīti vardhanaḥ ।anumānya yathā tattvam idam vacanam abravīt ॥4-59-11॥

translations.english: 'I was thinking, tormented with hunger, my son who always keeps me happy told me exactly what had happened:
translations.hindi: उन ऋषि के दर्शन करने की कामना से, जटायु के साथ ' पहिले भी में अनेक बार उनसे मिलने के लिए बड़े बड़े कष्ट मेल कर आया था

verses.sloka: अहम् तात यथा कालम् आमिष अर्थी खम् आप्लुतः ।महेन्द्रस्य गिरेः द्वारम् आवृत्य च सुसमाश्रितः ॥४-५९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: aham tāta yathā kālam āmiṣa arthī kham āplutaḥ ।mahendrasya gireḥ dvāram āvṛtya ca susamāśritaḥ ॥4-59-12॥

translations.english: 'O dear father I went to get food at the right time and stood blocking the entrance of mount Mahendra.
translations.hindi: उनके आश्रम के पास अति घुगन्धियुक्त पवन चल रहा था ओर वहाँ ऐसा एक भो वृत्त नहीं देख पड़ता था, जो फल्न फूत्ता न हो

verses.sloka: तत्र सत्त्व सहस्राणाम् सागर अन्तर चारिणाम् ।पंथानम् एको अध्यवसम् संनिरोद्धुम् अवाङ् मुखः ॥४-५९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tatra sattva sahasrāṇām sāgara antara cāriṇām ।paṁthānam eko adhyavasam saṁniroddhum avāṅ mukhaḥ ॥4-59-13॥

translations.english: 'There I stood alone looking down, obstructing the path of thousands of creatures inhabiting the ocean.

verses.sloka: तत्र कश्चित् मया दृष्टः सूर्य उदय सम प्रभाम् ।स्त्रियम् आदाय गच्छन् वै भिन्न अंजन चय उपमः ॥४-५९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tatra kaścit mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūrya udaya sama prabhām ।striyam ādāya gacchan vai bhinna aṁjana caya upamaḥ ॥4-59-14॥

translations.english: 'I saw a person who was dark and huge like a mass of collyrium carrying a lady whose radiance was like the rising Sun.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--'वा5पुष्पितः ? | \\ इतने में मैंने दूर से ऋषि को देखा कि, वे परम तेजस्वी दुर्धर्ष ऋषि स्नान करके उत्तर को मुख किए हुए चले आ रहे हैं

verses.sloka: सो अहम् अभ्यवहार अर्थम् तौ दृष्ट्वा कृत निश्चयः ।तेन साम्ना विनीतेन पन्थानम् अनुयाचितः ॥४-५९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: so aham abhyavahāra artham tau dṛṣṭvā kṛta niścayaḥ ।tena sāmnā vinītena panthānam anuyācitaḥ ॥4-59-15॥

translations.english: 'Since I was looking for food I resolved to seize both of them. (But) he asked me in a gentle and courteous manner to make way (since I was blocking the aerial path).

verses.sloka: न हि साम उपपन्नानाम् प्रहर्ता विद्यते भुवि ।नीचेषु अपि जनः कश्चित् किम् अङ्ग बत मत् विधः ॥४-५९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: na hi sāma upapannānām prahartā vidyate bhuvi ।nīceṣu api janaḥ kaścit kim aṅga bata mat vidhaḥ ॥4-59-16॥

translations.english: 'Who will strike polite people? Even the mean do not do it anywhere. And what to speak of me.
translations.hindi: राजा को अन्त.पुर में प्रविष्ट हुआ जान कर मंत्री, सैनिक आदि जिस प्रकार अपने अपने स्थानों को चले जाते हैं, उसी अकार उन ऋषिप्रवर को आश्रम में पहुँचा कर, वे सब जीवजन्तु आपने अपने स्थानों को चले गए

verses.sloka: स यातः तेजसा व्योम संक्षिपन् इव वेगतः ।अथ अहम् खे चरैः भूतैः अभिगम्य सभाजितः ॥४-५९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sa yātaḥ tejasā vyoma saṁkṣipan iva vegataḥ ।atha aham khe caraiḥ bhūtaiḥ abhigamya sabhājitaḥ ॥4-59-17॥

translations.english: 'He flew hurriedly with splendour as though he was enveloping the sky (making it small). All the flying creatures in the sky came and greeted me with respect.

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या जीवति सीत इति हि अब्रुवन् माम् महर्षयः ।कथंचित् स कलत्रः असौ गतः ते स्वस्ति असंशयम् ॥४-५९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā jīvati sīta iti hi abruvan mām maharṣayaḥ ।kathaṁcit sa kalatraḥ asau gataḥ te svasti asaṁśayam ॥4-59-18॥

translations.english: 'I heard the great sages saying, 'O dear you are lucky to be saved. He has somehow gone from here with that lady (without hurting you). Undoubtedly you are lucky.'
translations.hindi: ऋषि जा सुके देखते हुए ओर प्रसन्न होते हुए आश्रम में चले बोर सुहूत भर बाद पुनः आश्रम के वाहिर आ, मुझसे आने का कारण पूं छने लगे ॥९७] सोम्य 'बैकल्यतां दृष्टा रोम्णां ते नावगम्यते | अभिदग्धविमो पक्षो त्वक्चैव रणिता तव

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः ततो अहम् तैः सिद्धैः परम शोभनैः ।स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसाम् प्रतिवेदितः ॥४-५९-१९॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tato aham taiḥ siddhaiḥ parama śobhanaiḥ ।sa ca me rāvaṇo rājā rakṣasām prativeditaḥ ॥4-59-19॥

translations.english: 'I was greeted by the most illustrious siddhas. I came to know from them that he was Ravana, the king of demons. I was looking at him while he was abducting Janaka's daughter, who was the wife of Dasaratha's Rama. Her ornaments had dropped and silken robes had slipped since she lost hold on herself. She was crying, loudly calling out the names of Rama and Lakshmana, her hair dishevelled.

verses.sloka: पश्यन् दाशरथेः भार्याम् रामस्य जनक आत्मजाम् ।भ्रष्ट आभरण कौशेयाम् शोक वेग पराजिताम् ॥४-५९-२०॥
verses.transliteration: paśyan dāśaratheḥ bhāryām rāmasya janaka ātmajām ।bhraṣṭa ābharaṇa kauśeyām śoka vega parājitām ॥4-59-20॥

translations.english: 'I was greeted by the most illustrious siddhas. I came to know from them that he was Ravana, the king of demons. I was looking at him while he was abducting Janaka's daughter, who was the wife of Dasaratha's Rama. Her ornaments had dropped and silken robes had slipped since she lost hold on herself. She was crying, loudly calling out the names of Rama and Lakshmana, her hair dishevelled.
translations.hindi: हे सम्पाते ! उनमें तुम बड़े और जटायु तुम्हारा छोटा भाई है। तुम दोनों ने मनुष्य का रूप धर कर मेरे पैर छुए थे

verses.sloka: राम लक्ष्मणयोः नाम क्रोशन्तीम् मुक्त मूर्धजाम् ।एष काल अत्ययः तात इति वाक्यविदाम् वरः ॥४-५९-२१॥
verses.transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ nāma krośantīm mukta mūrdhajām ।eṣa kāla atyayaḥ tāta iti vākyavidām varaḥ ॥4-59-21॥

translations.english: 'O father this is the cause of my delay', said Suparshva, who knew the value of time. Thus he gave the entire account to me.
translations.hindi: तुम अपना समस्त हाल मुझसे कहो

verses.sloka: एतत् अर्थम् समग्रम् मे सुपार्श्वः प्रत्यवेदयत् ।तत् श्रुत्वा अपि हि मे बुद्धिः न आसीत् काचित् पराक्रमे ॥४-५९-२२॥
verses.transliteration: etat artham samagram me supārśvaḥ pratyavedayat ।tat śrutvā api hi me buddhiḥ na āsīt kācit parākrame ॥4-59-22॥

translations.english: 'Even after hearing this I could not advance (against Ravana). How could I, a vulture without wings, leap even a little?

verses.sloka: अपक्षो हि कथम् पक्षी कर्म किंचित् समारभेत् ।यत् तु शक्यम् मया कर्तुम् वाक् बुद्धि गुण वर्तिना ॥४-५९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: apakṣo hi katham pakṣī karma kiṁcit samārabhet ।yat tu śakyam mayā kartum vāk buddhi guṇa vartinā ॥4-59-23॥

translations.english: 'Being endowed with the faculty of thinking and speech I shall tell you what is possible for you to execute with your prowess. Listen.

verses.sloka: श्रूयताम् तत्र वक्ष्यामि भवताम् पौरुष आश्रयम् ।वाक् मतिभ्याम् हि सार्वेषाम् करिष्यामि प्रियम् हि वः ॥४-५९-२४॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyatām tatra vakṣyāmi bhavatām pauruṣa āśrayam ।vāk matibhyām hi sārveṣām kariṣyāmi priyam hi vaḥ ॥4-59-24॥

translations.english: 'I will please you with my word and thought and do not doubt that Rama's task is dear to me as well.

verses.sloka: यत् हि दाशरथेः कार्यम् मम तत् न अत्र संशयः ।तत् भवन्तो मति श्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः ॥४-५९-२५॥
verses.transliteration: yat hi dāśaratheḥ kāryam mama tat na atra saṁśayaḥ ।tat bhavanto mati śreṣṭhā balavanto manasvinaḥ ॥4-59-25॥

translations.english: 'Indeed, you monkeys are very wise, strong and sensitive. The king of monkeys has sent you on this mission. You cannot be conquered even by gods.

verses.sloka: प्रहिताः कपि राजेन देवैः अपि दुरासदाः ।राम लक्ष्मण बाणाः च निशिताः कंक पत्रिणः ॥४-५९-२६॥
verses.transliteration: prahitāḥ kapi rājena devaiḥ api durāsadāḥ ।rāma lakṣmaṇa bāṇāḥ ca niśitāḥ kaṁka patriṇaḥ ॥4-59-26॥

translations.english: 'The heronfeathered arrows of Rama and Lakshmana are sharp and strong enough to protect or subdue all the three worlds.

verses.sloka: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् पर्याप्ताः त्राण निग्रहे ।कामम् खलु दशग्रीवः तेजो बल समन्वितः ।भवताम् तु समर्थानाम् न किंचित् अपि दुष्करम् ॥४-५९-२७॥
verses.transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānām paryāptāḥ trāṇa nigrahe ।kāmam khalu daśagrīvaḥ tejo bala samanvitaḥ ।bhavatām tu samarthānām na kiṁcit api duṣkaram ॥4-59-27॥

translations.english: 'The tenheaded Ravana is mighty, powerful and strong, indeed. But you are efficient and it will not be difficult for you to achieve this task.

verses.sloka: तत् अलम् काल संगेन क्रियताम् बुद्धि निश्चयः ।न हि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवत् विधाः ॥४-५९-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tat alam kāla saṁgena kriyatām buddhi niścayaḥ ।na hi karmasu sajjante buddhimanto bhavat vidhāḥ ॥4-59-28॥

translations.english: 'Do not bother about the time limit. Resolve to achieve the objective, for wise people like you should not lag behind in accepting challenges.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
